{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Drop the 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99
df_valid = df_completed[df_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue of valid completed orders
mean_revenue = df_valid['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
mean_revenue"}
